action.command:
cd /workspace/project && timeout 300 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,collections
def analyze(num):
    key=[x.strip() for x in [l for l in open("ob_accounts.txt") if l.startswith(num)][0].split("|")][1]
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/transactions",headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {key}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=40) as x: items=json.load(x)["transactions"]
    amts=[(abs(float(t["amount"])), t["created_at"]) for t in items]
    h=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0.0])
    for a,ts in amts:
        if a>=0.999: continue
        k=ts[11:13]; h[k][0]+=1; h[k][1]+=a
    tot=sum(a for a,_ in amts if a<0.999)
    print(f"\n### akun {num} | {len([1 for a,_ in amts if a<0.999])} req | total ${tot:.4f}")
    print("   jam (UTC) -> req, biaya")
    for k in sorted(h):
        n,s=h[k]; print(f"     {k}:00 -> {n:3} req ${s:.4f}")
    big=sorted([x for x in amts if 0.002<x[0]<0.999],reverse=True)[:5]
    print("   5 transaksi terbesar:", ", ".join(f"${a:.5f}@{ts[11:16]}" for a,ts in big))
analyze("4139081360506558")
analyze("5179772977153174")
PY
